meta.title: DAIRE Central -> Lender Result Broadcast — Data Format

headers.X-API-Key: SENT ONLY WHEN REQUIRE_API_KEYS=true on Central; value = the LENDER_CALLBACK_API_KEY the lender issued to Central. In current trusted-network mode no key header is sent.

notes: Central appends /api/daire/central/receive/ to the registered base URL automatically.
A base URL that already ends with the receive path is accepted as-is.
The connection is initiated BY CENTRAL — the lender receiver must listen on 0.0.0.0 and allow Central's IP (172.17.16.76).

borrower_reference.description: The reference THIS lender holds for the customer (the customer_id it reported on the account), falling back to the borrower's NIDA number. Match your customer on this field.

central_borrower_reference.description: Central's unified borrower reference (audit trail; same person may be merged across lenders on nida_number).

result_type.description: Kind of broadcast. CREDIT_RESULT = combined AI + blockchain decision envelope (the normal case).

assessment_reference.description: Central's assessment this result belongs to.

result.description: Backwards-compatible SINGLE result: the most recently generated score (AI or blockchain) with a 'kind' discriminator.

results.description: Combined payload: both engines. 'ai' and 'blockchain' are each nullable when that engine has no result for the assessment.

strengths: Zero derogatory defaults on record across reporting institutions.
Low debt burden: Debt-to-Income is 7.0% (well under 35% benchmark).
Identity & income verified across official banking sources.

success_response.description: Lender matched the payload to its customer and stored it. Real response captured from the NMB lender receiver:

field_notes.matched: true = payload's borrower_reference matched a customer on the lender side
field_notes.record_id: lender-side id of the stored result (CCIS- prefix)
field_notes.customer_id: the lender's own customer id it matched

success_response.central_interpretation: Any 2xx marks the broadcast COMPLETED in Central's DataExchange audit log.

non_field_errors: A customer_id, nida_number, borrower_reference, or assessment reference is required.

401_authentication.when: REQUIRE_API_KEYS=true on Central but the X-API-Key the lender expects is missing/wrong
401_authentication.note: Central sends X-API-Key only when key enforcement is enabled; the value is the lender-issued LENDER_CALLBACK_API_KEY.

host_unreachable.when: Receiver not running / firewall blocks Central
host_unreachable.central_error: Could not reach http://<host>:<port>/api/daire/central/receive/ — the service may be offline or unreachable from this host.

disallowed_host.when: Lender's Django ALLOWED_HOSTS missing Central's IP (172.17.16.76)

retry_and_audit.audit_record: Every attempt (success or failure) is stored in Central's DataExchange log: system=LENDER, direction=PUSH, operation=broadcast_credit_result, with payload, status and full lender response.
retry_and_audit.recipients: One push per lender linked to the borrower's accounts (deduplicated), so all contributing lenders receive the combined result.
retry_and_audit.automatic: Auto-broadcast runs at the end of the blockchain-score step when enabled (default ON): the UI shows 'Auto-broadcast results to lenders (NMB + CRDB) when the assessment completes'.
